examples.original: [clean] Start by identifying the object's likely locations based on its type and common usage.
examples.control: [clean] Rotate crops so that no family grows in the same patch year after year.

examples.original: [clean] Always clean the object using a sinkbasin before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Cut back spent flower stalks so that the plant directs energy into new growth.

examples.original: [clean] Check the most probable locations first, such as the diningtable, sinkbasin, or storage areas like cabinets and drawers.
examples.control: [clean] Choose disease-resistant varieties whenever the catalogue offers them, for crops potatoes that suffer from blight in humid summers.

examples.original: [clean] If the object is not found in initial locations, systematically check other likely storage or usage areas.
examples.control: [clean] Net the currant berry bushes before the fruit ripens, or the birds will strip them within days.
